snippet.title: Plantverk: Perfectly Plantastic Plant Simulator - Early Trailer
snippet.description:
Early Trailer for Plantverk: Perfectly Plantastic Plant Simulator

Create your perfect little Greenhouse with fantastic plants, fun decorations and more in this cozy idle game! Throw your harvests around and cause havoc, and then use the vacuum to clean up your mess (for profit of course). Use your well-earned money to buy decorations, unlock new plants and pots.

Wishlist Plantverk on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3922410
